result.question: Como a taxa de internacao por mil habitantes em 2021 varia por quintil de PIB per capita?
result.gold_sql: WITH mun AS (SELECT s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D", s."VL_PIB_PERCAPITA", s."QT_POPULACAO", NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY s."VL_PIB_PERCAPITA") AS quintil_pib FROM socioeconomico s WHERE s."NU_ANO" = 2021 AND s."VL_PIB_PERCAPITA" IS NOT NULL AND s."QT_POPULACAO" > 0), adm AS (SELECT "MUNIC_RES" AS municipio_codigo, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") = 2021 GROUP BY "MUNIC_RES") SELECT quintil_pib, COUNT(*) AS municipios, SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)) AS total_internacoes, SUM(mun."QT_POPULACAO") AS populacao, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(adm.total_internacoes, 0)) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mun."QT_POPULACAO"), 0), 2) AS internacoes_por_mil FROM mun LEFT JOIN adm ON mun."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" = adm.municipio_codigo GROUP BY quintil_pib ORDER BY quintil_pib;
